design_provenance: This bundle materializes statistical columns already declared in wma-main-table-spec.v2. It was frozen while Wave-1 had no complete seed, no three-seed summary, and zero admitted numeric result rows; no score was inspected to choose a metric or comparator.

metric_surface.analysis_unit: original sample cluster with all QA inside the sample retained together

tables.name: method_seed_statistics
tables.content: All 22 methods by all 55 fixed method-level metrics, with mean, sample SD, and each seed value.

tables.name: agentenhance_pairwise
tables.content: AgentEnhance against each of 21 public implementations for every fixed metric; 23 decomposable metrics receive paired cluster inference and 32 run-level/count metrics remain seed-level descriptive.

tables.name: slice_seed_statistics
tables.content: All 22 methods by all 53 frozen slices by all 8 slice metrics, retaining three-seed variability.

paired_inference.scope: Only rows whose analysis_unit is paired_original_sample_cluster. Run-level resources, timing summaries, token totals, and count fields remain seed_level_descriptive with blank confidence intervals.
paired_inference.seed_aggregation: Within each bootstrap draw, recompute each ratio from the selected original-sample clusters separately for seeds 0, 1, and 2; average the three seed-level ratios; then take AgentEnhance minus comparator.

paired_sufficient_statistics.validation_evidence: All 23 paired metric formulas exactly reproduced the frozen aggregate_metrics.json values for each of MMFU_Single, SimpleMem, M2A, and ViLoMem on the retained real-sample smoke artifact: 92 checks at rel_tol=abs_tol=1e-12.

pairwise_computation.raw_to_aggregate_gate_per_pair: 138 exact checks: 2 methods x 3 seeds x 23 metrics, rel_tol=abs_tol=1e-12
pairwise_computation.synthetic_test_evidence: All 23 metrics passed deterministic repeatability, exact three-seed point-estimate, positive-orientation, interval-ordering, and identical-input zero-difference checks.

admission: Numeric cells remain empty until their source methods are independently terminal-accepted. The pairwise table remains locked until both AgentEnhance and the named comparator are accepted under the same protocol.
prohibited: dropping a metric, comparator, seed, slice, or failed sample after observing results
using an unmatched official number in any numeric cell
interpreting a confidence interval as paired when sample identities or denominators differ
calling a descriptive count metric superior
